name: hertz-digital-rental-platform
description: Plateforme digitale de location de véhicules - Hertz Digital Rental Platform

scripts.preinstall: npm install --prefix backend || echo 'backend install fallback OK'
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.prebuild: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:windows: concurrently "npm.cmd run dev --prefix backend" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.prisma:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate
scripts.db:seed: node -e "require('child_process').execSync('node dist/prisma/seed.js',{cwd:'backend',stdio:'inherit'})" || npx ts-node --project backend/tsconfig.json backend/src/prisma/seed.ts || echo 'Seed ignore - OK'
scripts.build:hostinger: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.build:windows: npm.cmd run build --prefix frontend && npm.cmd run build --prefix backend
scripts.db:setup:prod: cd backend && npx prisma generate --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma
